text:
```yaml
name: Auto-regenerate cargo-vet exemptions
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  regenerate-exemptions:
    if: >
      github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' &&
      contains(github.event.pull_request.changed_files, 'Cargo.lock') &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install cargo-vet
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-vet

      - name: Regenerate exemptions
        run: |
          cargo vet regenerate exemptions

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            git config user.name "dependabot[bot]"
            git config user.email "49699333+dependabot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git add supply-chain/audits.toml
            git commit -m "chore: auto-update cargo-vet exemptions"
            git push
          fi
```
